description.value: Nootka Sound Resort is a luxury all-inclusive floating fishing lodge moored at Galiano Bay in Nootka Sound, reachable only by boat or floatplane. Operated by Nootka Marine Adventures, it offers private suites, gourmet meals, guided salmon and halibut fishing, kayaking, and stand-up paddleboarding in sheltered waters. The resort is open June through August and caters primarily to fishing groups and corporate retreats.
